full_prompt_en: A square painterly photographic portrait shows a weathered middle-aged man from the chest upward against a nearly black teal backdrop. He faces forward, slightly turned at the shoulders, with a broad cloud of unruly reddish brown curls spreading around his head. His face sits near the vertical center: deep set eyes look directly outward beneath the hair, while a rough beard and lined cheeks give the expression a quiet, grave weight. A dark scarf circles his neck and partly hides the collar. Across his shoulders and torso, a loosely draped wrap moves through burnt orange, brick red, mustard yellow, dark green, and muted blue. Its broad folds form the brightest area of the image, with worn textile texture visible where the colors overlap. The left sleeve and lower edge dissolve quickly into shadow. Behind him, the backdrop has a mottled, softly brushed teal glow around the head and shoulders, then falls to deep black at the corners. The lighting is warm and directional from the upper left, catching the hair, forehead, nose, and textured cloth; the far side of his face remains softly dark. There is no visible setting or additional object. The frame combines intimate eye contact with a restrained, almost ceremonial stillness. Rich earth colors, tactile surfaces, dark negative space, and a subtle painterly finish carry the mood across the whole square composition.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、带绘画质感的摄影肖像描绘一名中年男子的胸像，身后是近乎黑色的深青背景。他面朝前方，肩膀略微转开，一团蓬松凌乱的红褐卷发向头部四周散开。面孔位于画面纵向中央附近：深陷的眼睛从发下直视观者，粗糙胡须与带纹路的面颊使表情安静而凝重。深色围巾绕过颈部，遮住一部分领口。松垂的裹布跨过肩膀与躯干，颜色从焦橙、砖红、芥黄延伸至深绿和灰蓝。宽阔布褶构成画面最明亮区域，颜色相叠处可见旧布纹理。左侧衣袖与下缘迅速融入阴影。背后背景在头肩附近呈斑驳、柔刷的青绿色微光，四角逐渐坠入深黑。暖而有方向的光从左上照来，触及头发、额头、鼻梁和有纹理的布料；脸另一侧保持柔暗。没有可见场所或其他物件。画面将亲近的眼神接触与克制、近乎仪式化的静止结合。厚实的大地色、可触的表面、深色留白和微妙的绘画式收尾贯穿整个方形构图。
style_prompt_en: A square painterly photographic treatment uses a concentrated warm focal zone inside broad dark negative space. Deep teal and black ground tones carry a faint mottled texture, while saturated earth pigments appear in layered, irregular swaths near the center. Directional upper side light reveals rough surface grain, soft edge halos, and a few sharply legible highlights; forms on the far side descend gently into dense shadow. Focus is strongest around the central feature, then loosens into velvety blur and brushlike transitions toward the perimeter. The palette balances burnt orange and red against cool blue green, with muted yellow connecting them. Tonal compression at the corners makes the central color and texture feel luminous. The finished image has solemn stillness, tactile richness, and the depth of an old master painting filtered through photographic detail.
style_prompt_zh: 方形绘画感摄影把集中的暖色焦点放在宽阔的深色留白之中。深青与黑色底调带细微斑驳纹理，饱和大地色在中央附近形成层叠而不规则的色带。上方侧向光揭出粗糙表面颗粒、柔软边缘晕光和少量清晰高光；远光侧形体平缓沉入浓影。焦点在中心特征处最锐，向外围逐渐松散为天鹅绒般的虚化和笔刷式过渡。色板以焦橙、红色对照冷蓝绿色，再用暗黄将两者连接。四角压缩的明度令中央颜色与纹理显得发光。成品具有凝重静止感、可触的丰厚质地，以及摄影细节经过古典绘画过滤后的深度。
theme_en: A weathered curly-haired man in a vivid wrap against a deep teal portrait backdrop
theme_zh: 深青色背景前披着鲜亮裹布的卷发沧桑男子肖像
name: Andres Serrano
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
